Rejects an unknown external finding offset encoding

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract_with_external_redaction;
use xberg::ExternalRedactionFinding;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"bytes":[90,97,114,110,97,107],"filename":"external-findings-invalid.txt","kind":"bytes","mime_type":"text/plain"}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let findings_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"[{"label":"inspection_person","score":0.99,"text":"Zarnak"}]"#).unwrap();
    let findings = serde_json::from_value::<Vec<ExternalRedactionFinding>>(findings_json).unwrap();
    let offset_encoding = Some(r#"bytes-ish"#);
    let max_findings = Some(8);
    let result = extract_with_external_redaction(input, &config, findings, offset_encoding.as_deref(), max_findings).await;
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
